$comment: The pinned rocut upstream this plugin vendors. vendor/ is NOT committed (see .gitignore), so THIS committed file is the pin of record: without it a fresh clone would have no way to know which commit to build from. `npm run vendor` refuses to pack an upstream checkout whose HEAD is not this commit. Moving the pin is a deliberate edit here, reviewed like any other change.
prerequisites: cd apps/vite-example && OPENCUT_PUBLIC_BASE=./ bun run build
